item.title: Wisconsin railway tunnel reopens after seven years, recalling a remarkable 1887 construction feat
item.description: The Stewart Tunnel in Wisconsin has officially reopened for cyclists after an extensive restoration initiative. It was closed in 2019 due to safety hazards associated with falling rocks, prompting significant renovation work. Originally constructed in 1886 for the Illinois Central Railroad, the tunnel historically facilitated passenger and freight transport until the 1970s. The restoration included adding a metal liner and drainage to enhance safety while maintaining its historic character. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
